info.title: ShadowDuskCLI
info.description: Cross-platform drop-in replacement for MonoGame's mgfxc shader compiler — compiles .fx to .mgfx (MonoGame/KNI) and D3D9 fx_2_0 .fxb (FNA), self-contained on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

options.name: /Profile
options.description:

options.name: /DxbcBackend
options.description:
DXBC backend for DirectX_11. Default: vkd3d
(cross-platform). d3dcompiler is the Windows-only
correctness oracle; never required for correct output.
